scope: superseded exploratory and diagnostic attempts; none is acceptance evidence

attempts.cause: brew migrate was invoked before Homebrew's installed old-tap clone had fetched the newly committed tap_migrations.json metadata
attempts.disposition: superseded; acceptance flow uses explicit brew update after publishing metadata to the local-only old-tap remote

attempts.cause: an unqualified diagnostic command was ambiguous while both disposable taps were present
attempts.disposition: superseded; topology transitions use fully qualified identities at ambiguity boundaries

attempts.symptom: upgraded taskfleet remained identified with jarimustonen/orchestratectl and direct canonical install refused duplicate ownership
attempts.cause: the diagnostic manually supplied new-tap formula rename metadata without first updating the installed old tap, so it renamed the keg but never exercised the intended tap-migration update boundary
attempts.disposition: superseded setup error; not product evidence

attempts.symptom: The migration did not complete successfully; the already-moved Cellar path was missing
attempts.cause: the diagnostic added optional new-tap formula_renames.json on top of the prepared old-tap tap_migrations.json; brew update scheduled both rename records and attempted the same keg migration twice
attempts.disposition: superseded; the prepared old-tap cross-tap mapping already includes the new formula token, so the acceptance flow uses that single source of migration truth

attempts.symptom: receipt assertion looked only at Cellar/taskfleet/0.5.1
attempts.cause: the first assertion hard-coded the pre-migration rack version path; the next diagnostic corrected that but searched for .INSTALL_RECEIPT.json instead of Homebrew's INSTALL_RECEIPT.json
attempts.disposition: superseded assertion errors; acceptance discovers the sole correctly named migrated receipt below the Taskfleet rack and verifies its source.tap

attempts.symptom: exact Homebrew version guard rejected before creating a sandbox
attempts.cause: the host Homebrew checkout advanced between initial tool capture and review hardening while retaining the later recorded git commit
attempts.disposition: superseded stale tool metadata; final acceptance pins both the exact current version string and git commit
